title: Trace every Task to a user story
statement: As an architect, I can rely on every Task leading to a user story, directly or through the Tasks it unblocks, so all planned work traces back to why we are doing it and the chain of dependencies is clear.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Task that neither links to a user story nor unblocks a Task that leads to one is refused, whatever kind of work it describes.
A Plan's page lists the stories its Tasks lead to, grouped by feature.
A reader can follow links from a Plan to a Task, through any Tasks it unblocks, to a story, and to that story's feature.
A change that would leave a Task with no path to a story is refused, and names the Tasks it would strand.
